title: Active Weepinbell Ambush sends the player one tile south

verification.actor: One current Wild Weepinbell (species 70) on Route 29 with active Ambush Jump1 contact profile.
verification.trigger: From checked placement, let Weepinbell start its own ordinary Ambush Hop over the stationary player. Accept the first airborne swept-body contact with active attacking=1, minImpactSpeed=16, and collisionDamage=20.
verification.observable: At the crossing frame player and saved HP change from 100 to 80 once. The player uses the native jump command and arc, then lands at (585,408), even if Weepinbell occupies that tile. No walking knockback, battle, or recovery occurs.

setupMutations.change: Copy unchanged test.nds and test.sav into a disposable session, teleport the player to map 33 (585,407), spawn one Wild Weepinbell at (585,404), and bind its current native identity. Do not force the Ambush, motion, HP, or RNG.

limits: Prepared placement proves ordinary Ambush motion after spawn, not natural Wild population selection.
The bounded wait fails if the first normal Ambush does not cross the player. It never forces a Hop or damage.
The player lands one tile along the incoming Ambush direction. Pokémon occupancy does not block this knockback; walls and NPCs still can. Native pose and HP reads replace image or video capture.

events.value: Bind the prepared Wild Weepinbell and read the player's initial 100 HP.
Observe the active Ambush profile and one ordinary airborne Hop crossing the player.
Read 80 HP at the crossing, then observe one native south player jump ending one tile away.

stop.condition: The first qualifying airborne Ambush contact, exact 20-HP loss, and finished one-tile south jump; or the first missing identity, profile, motion, HP, or field-control proof.

invariants: One current Wild Weepinbell resolves active Ambush with attacking 1/16/20 and Jump1
Its ordinary airborne Hop body crosses the stationary player with no forced input
One contact reduces player and saved HP from 100 to 80; the player jumps exactly one tile south and no battle or recovery starts
